issue_context.title: Move all benchmarks to the root level `benches` folder
issue_context.body:
Location: https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/tree/master/benches

There are currently several benchmarks scattered elsewhere, and they should be consolidated. 

During this process, we need to be sure we remove the relevant benchmark dev-dependencies from the "real" crates, in order to reduce their dependency trees and improve compile and CI times.

[Discord](https://discord.com/channels/691052431525675048/692572690833473578/812059596054200340) context.
comments: According to @cart, [bevymark](https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/master/examples/tools/bevymark.rs) should probably still live in `examples`, rather than `benches` due to being interactive and not producing quantitative output to compare against.
Since am interested in that, might I be assigned to it? Should be the transform benchmark be uncommented?
Sure thing! Lets just remove the transform benchmark. Its out of date and we should come up with a new one that uses the new system (but I'd say thats not in scope for this issue).
Then I think that using a single framework for all of them makes sense too in a follow up.
